hook_line: INDIA TAKES FORWARD SIX UREA PLANTS IN PUSH FOR SELF-RELIANCE

hook_stat.sub: Approximate investment in six brownfield urea plants under NIPU-2026

stats.label: Brownfield urea plants taken forward under NIPU-2026
Annual installed capacity of each project
Annual urea consumption in India, against production of 293.30 LMT in 2025-26

diaspora_bullets: Reducing reliance on imported urea is meant to save foreign exchange and strengthen availability for farmers
Brownfield sites come with existing land, utilities and infrastructure, which enables faster execution
news_summary: India has taken forward six brownfield urea plants under the National Investment Policy for Urea (NIPU)-2026, with an investment of approximately ₹54,000 crore, and each project carries an annual installed capacity of 12.7 lakh metric tonnes.
payoff: India's annual urea consumption is around 400 LMT against production of 293.30 LMT in 2025-26 — the gap the expansion is meant to narrow.
